title: Identifying High-Confidence Social Biases in LLMs for Trustworthy Conversational Tutoring Agents

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLMs' ability to classify embedded statements (derived from the StereoSet benchmark) within generated student-tutor conversational dialogues as stereotypical, anti-stereotypical, or neutral, while simultaneously measuring the models' self-reported confidence scores to detect overconfident incorrect judgments.
